case_reviews.review_notes: Compared primary M2964 10x-with-glutamine source with original DSMZ403 historical042-1545 product and current21540 comparator. An additional source-qualified owner would not establish a distinct substance; unknown product/preparation and possible overlap justify the explicit hold. Case36 alone has the catalogue binding.

Three source recipes add blood or yeast/NAD/hemin separately to Columbia base. The original sources do not specify a common vendor/base formula, while the published OxoidCM0331 has a distinct formula. Hold avoids choosing one product across heterogeneous basal occurrences.

Original ATCC1047/957 explicitly says Noble(Difco0142), independently supported by the historical0142-01-8 study. Grade binding is supported; no0142→214220 packaging-equivalence claim is needed. Case121 remains excluded.

Read primary JCM1305: one OxoidSkirrow vial is reconstituted with2ml sterile purified water;0.4ml is receiving dose. Partial stock asserts the two inputs only, without importing modernSR0069 catalogue or full Helicobacter composition.

Original DSMZ403 explicitly prints GIBCO042-1545. Root cross-shard lookup exposed existingCMRL_1066 owner/source1680 with this catalogue in its source attribute. Final must reuse that owner and flag worker07; new duplicate would fail identity exclusivity. Slash/glutamine wording remains source text, not invented quantitative composition.

Original TOGOM2852 quotation identifies OxoidWilkins-Chalgren agar plates before blood/antibiotic supplementation. Prepared plate material is bounded; no dryCM0619 formula or unknown historical catalogue is substituted.

DSMZ1144 says Difco agar-agar without grade. The existence of Bacto and Noble supplier grades makes manufacturer alone insufficient; this is a real source-grade distinction, not deferred owner lookup.
Original JCM905/906 explicitBD-DifcoBacto grade remains supported; revised binding must describe84 unwashed subset while excludingP1washed subset. No global rawBacto alias or implicit release.

Read DSMZ840 original: BBL4354005 Columbia plates with5%sheep blood are one alternative to Trypticase soy plates. Proposal retains finished blood-containing product-family boundary and does not absorb the alternative.
Read NBRC1365: ready-to-use BD-BBL Columbia5%sheep blood. Supports the same named supplier/product family as67 without claiming lot-equivalent formulations or catalogue succession.

Read all four occurrence contexts and raw P1 washing instruction (600ml water, settle/remove overlay, repeat twice, final wet volume<300ml). Three unwashed grade occurrences and one washed preparation require distinct bindings. No has-part edge or retained wash-water mass is inferred.

Chocolate-agar ontology represents the general heated-blood medium class. TOGOM2975 adds IsoVitaleX separately; source annotation to existing owner is appropriate, without new duplicate, supplier assertion or supplement incorporation.
Existing Noble grade proposal remains supported by its supplier-qualified source. Successor adds0142 case8 without changing substance scope or resolving contradictory214050 case121.
Original M460-derived BactoBD-Difco conditional solidifier remains same grade; condition belongs to recipe. Superseding proposal retains this case and correctly separates washedP1.

NBRC1116 gives OxoidL28 only as an example of purified agar. A generic purification adjective does not select that product, Noble or another exact mixture. Missing selected product/grade criteria is a real source gap.

Independently read full NBRC1096. The source-defined family expressly permits natural aged OR DaigoSP seawater and optional agar. Only invariant inputs7.5gMarineBroth,5gpyruvate,200mlwater are unconditional components; branch quantities800ml/15g remain notes. Phenanthrene51mg and ethanol6ml belong to overlay, not this base. Family scope is honest and does not claim one exact composition.

NBRC1326 explicitly qualifies agarose as electrophoresis grade. Generic polymer identity2511 is retained with supplied-form note; supplier/gel strength/EEO unspecified. Narrow annotation is supported. Inherited Sepharose and non-name aliases and roles remain complete-owner release concerns, not newly reviewed claims.

TOGOM2850 identifies prepared Bordet-Gengou before sheep blood but no supplier/formula. Existing Difco438 preparation and dry248200 product cannot be selected from that text. Hold preserves the unproven equivalence rather than inventing a second potentially identical source-labelled substance.

Original CCAPMY75S is biphasic. Thoroughly disperse the agar in cold is a preparation instruction, not an ingredient. The required source repair is full phase/stock reconstruction, not a new owner or simple token deletion.

TOGOM2942 primary unit is1L prepared Mueller-Hinton agar; frozen1g/L is a separate conversion error. New source-qualified prepared material stays distinct from dryMHII product; atmosphere is not composition, and no generic ontology formula is borrowed.

Original ATCC1962 itself combines Noble wording with BD214050, which manufacturer evidence identifies as Bacto. Conflicting original claims justify hold; authenticated old0142 Noble cannot resolve it.
Supplier-qualified Noble source remains bound to same grade; new0142 evidence supports family continuity without a catalogue replacement claim. Inherited holds retained.

Primary finder→JCM418→JCM13 chain is explicit. Independently checked15main-batch inputs and subordinate-stock notes against full JCM13; quantities match. Horse blood makes this a finished formulation rather than Nissui dry BL product. Generic old alias remains provenance only.
Primary finder→JCM76→JCM26 chain is explicit. Checked all10batch inputs; extra50gNaCl belongs to JCM76 receiving medium and is excluded.1Lwater is an input, not an assumed final volume.

JCM119 explicitly uses37gBD-DifcoBCYE agar,100mlLegionella enrichment and900mlwater. Dry basal product is distinct from enrichment and finished medium. Failed manufacturer insert retrieval is acknowledged; source supplier/product boundary remains adequate.

DSMZ1775/source2177 distinguishes31.5g dry DG18 base from220g added glycerol. Existing imported owner can preserve that opaque named base; no vendor or formula is imposed from Oxoid/Merck comparators.

Read original DSMZ438: title explicitly saysDIFCO and separate15%horse blood. Source2112 measures1000mlprepared base, distinct from dry product98 and sheep-blood111. Existing imported owner can be narrowed with historical aliases retained as provenance.

Primary finder702 is pooled acrossBD-Difco JCM150/220,Nissui1329 andOxoidCM103 DSMZ831; equal17g doses do not establish equivalence. Frozen KG record lacks occurrence ID selecting one. Hold is justified even though supplier-specific candidates exist.

Primary finder→JCM51→JCM50 chain is explicit. Full JCM50 heats20goatmeal, filters and restores infusion1L before1mltrace stock and18gagar. Payload correctly asserts filtered infusion rather than20g retained whole oats; no dry-vendor identity borrowed.

Read DSMZ585: OxoidCYEbase plus BCYEsupplement is one commercial alternative; scratch ACES recipe is another. Source2125 names the combined system in1000ml. Two qualitative components with unknown amounts are appropriate; no scratch amounts or exact supplement catalogue inferred.
